blind.description: A freestanding tabletop bird or familiar perch consisting of a tiered circular wooden base trimmed with gold bands, a turned central wooden post with brass rings, a shallow circular brass catch-tray midway up, and a horizontal wooden crossbar wrapped with brown leather in the center and capped with rounded finials. Attached near one end of the crossbar is a small brass feed/water cup.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly above, it appears as a horizontal brown bar with a tan wrap over concentric circular dark wood and brass rings, with a small circular golden bowl projecting out to the left side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and about 1.5 ft wide across the crossbar.

notes: crossbar slightly wider than catalog proportions relative to height, but reads cleanly as requested
